I've saved the new release process to project memory: releases are cut with `make release`, which tags and publishes. It replaces the old memory that said to push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag and let CI publish, so the outdated one won't come up as current anymore.

There's no `release` target in any Makefile on this branch (`main`) yet, so `make release` won't work from here right now. If the target is on another branch or still waiting to be merged, that's probably why. I noted this in the memory as well.
